description: This file defines the React component 'NodesPage' used as a page in a web UI to monitor and manage agent nodes within an orchestration platform. It includes imports, hooks, state management, event handling for WebSocket/SSE events for real-time node updates, filtering, and rendering UI components like search, status summaries, and node lists.

methods.name: formatRelativeTime
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a relative string (e.g., '3h ago').

methods.name: handleBulkRefresh
methods.description: Handles the bulk refresh of node statuses, updating multiple nodes' statuses.

methods.name: handleRefreshError
methods.description: Handles errors during status refresh procedures.
